DearSir
Subject:
NoticeofBookClosurefor13thQuarterlyProfitPaymentofPrivatelyPlaced,DSLRListed
TermFinanceIssue(TFC-VIm) Issue of Rs.6.000Million (DatedMarch 17,2020)
This is to informyou that the13thquarterlyprofit payment of Rated,Unsecured,OTC ListedPerpetual Term
Finance Certificates(TFC-VI1) Issue of Rs.6,000 Million (Issue date March 17,2020)of the Bank is due on
June 17,2023.The transfer books pertaining to this issue shall remain closed from June 9, 2023 to
June16,2023(both days inclusive).
You may please inform the TRE Certificate Holders of the Exchange accordingly.
Yours truly
Syed Ali Safdar Nar
